questions.q: Matthew opens with Jesus as the son of David and the son of whom?
questions.evidence: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham

questions.q: What gifts did the wise men offer the child?
questions.evidence: Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh

questions.q: "Man shall not live by" what "alone", Jesus answered the tempter?
questions.evidence: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God

questions.q: Who are blessed, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven, as the sermon begins?
questions.evidence: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven

questions.q: How does the prayer Jesus taught begin?
questions.evidence: Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy

questions.q: Which disciple stepped out of the boat and walked on the water?
questions.evidence: Peter stepped down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to Jesus

questions.q: What did Jesus say he would build on this rock?
questions.evidence: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it

questions.q: Which three did Jesus take up the high mountain where he was changed?
questions.evidence: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves

questions.q: How much was Judas paid to deliver Jesus?
questions.evidence: They weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver

questions.q: Who was compelled to carry the cross of Jesus?
questions.evidence: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross

questions.q: Of whom did Jesus send the eleven to make disciples?
questions.evidence: Go, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit
